info.title: Notifiable API
info.description: A simple example ASP.NET Core Web API

post.description: Create a new organization. The calling user becomes the owner.

get.description: List all organizations the current user belongs to.

delete.description: Permanently delete an organization and remove all memberships.

put.description: Update an organization's name or timezone.

get.description: Get the organization membership for the current user.

post.description: Create a new API key for the organization. The raw key is only returned once.

get.description: List all API keys for the organization.

get.summary: Get an API key by ID.
get.description: Retrieve a single API key by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Permanently revoke an API key by ID.

post.description: Fetch a notification for a user and mark it as read.

get.description: Count unread internal notifications for a user.
List internal notifications for a user.

get.summary: Get current status of a notification.
get.description: Returns the overall status and the list of delivery attempts aggregated across providers.

get.summary: Retrieve notifications for the selected organization.
get.description: Returns a paged list of notifications that belong to the organization identified by the X-Organization-Id header. Supports filtering by title, body, status, channel, and read state.

post.summary: Enqueue a notification for async delivery (email, sms, or push).
post.description: Accepts a template reference (preferred) or inline content and channel-specific recipients. Returns a correlation Id.
Create a new provider configuration for an organization channel.

get.description: List all providers for an organization.
Retrieve a single provider by its unique identifier.

post.description: Make this provider the default for its channel.

get.description: List all available provider types that can be configured.
Get the configuration schema for a specific provider type.

post.description: Create a channel for an organization.

get.description: List all channels for an organization.
Retrieve a single channel by its unique identifier.

put.description: Update an existing template by ID.

get.description: Retrieve a single template by its unique identifier.

post.description: Resolve a template by (Id or Code) within an organization/channel/language with optional fallback.

get.description: Retrieve a paged list of templates for an organization.

post.description: Create a new notification template for an organization.

get.description: List registered devices for a contact.

post.description: Register or update a device token for a contact.
Delete a contact within an organization.

get.description: Get a contact by id within an organization.

put.description: Update an existing contact within an organization.

get.description: List contacts for an organization with optional search.

post.description: Create or update a contact within an organization.
Include or exclude a contact in a static audience.
Create an audience (static list or dynamic segment).

get.description: List audiences for an organization.
Get contacts belonging to an audience (static list or dynamic segment).
Get an audience by id within an organization.

post.description: Remove a contact from a static audience.
Push a real-time event to connected subscription clients.
Generate a new token for a subscription client.
Mark a notification as read for a subscription client.

get.description: Count unread notifications for a subscription client.
Retrieve notifications for a subscription client.

ErrorResponse.description: the dto used to send an error response to the client

statusCode.description: the http status code sent to the client. default is 400.

message.description: the message for the error response

errors.description: the collection of errors for the current context
